objective: Define and test evidence invalidation and reuse contracts for the verification cache
overview: Evidence invalidation and reuse ensures that cached verification results are only reused when safe to do so. The cache contract guarantees that failures are never silently converted to passes.

commit_mismatch.description: Cache invalid when commit SHA changes

changed_files_mismatch.description: Cache invalid when changed files differ

fingerprint_mismatch.description: Cache invalid when fingerprint (tool version) changes

tree_digest_mismatch.description: Cache invalid when working-tree content of changed files differs

cached_fail.description: Cached FAIL -> reusable=True, exit_code=1 (never assume PASS)

invalid_cache.description: Invalid cache -> reusable=False, caller decides what to do

contract_invariants.description: exit_code must never be 0 when stored status is fail
reusable=True only when cache is valid
Caller must decide what to do when cache is invalid
Never transform a previously recorded failure into success

TestCacheInvalidation.coverage: commit mismatch, files mismatch, fingerprint mismatch, all match

TestCacheReuse.coverage: pass replay, fail replay, fail contract, invalid cache

TestCachedVerdict.coverage: pass verdict, fail verdict, unit statuses

TestReplayResult.coverage: pass result, fail result, invalid result

TestCacheContract.coverage: exit_code never 0 for fail, reusable only when valid, caller decides

success_criteria: Cache invalidates on changed files mismatch
Cache reuses correctly for valid state
Contract invariant: exit_code never 0 for FAIL
Contract invariant: caller decides on invalid cache
